This leader will establish common operating practices, strengthen collaboration across business lines, clarify ownership, and modernize delivery through automation, artificial intelligence, and innovative operating models.
  
  
Success will require significant experience leading large-scale technology delivery organizations, strong commercial and financial acumen, executive presence, and the ability to drive accountability across a complex matrixed environment. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading through organizational change and operational uncertainty, stabilizing customers in crisis, challenging legacy approaches, and making difficult decisions while maintaining the trust of customers, employees, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Enterprise Client Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Own overall service delivery execution across the North American client delivery organization.
* Provide leadership across an organization of more than 1,000 delivery professionals supporting a business portfolio exceeding $1 billion annually.
* Ensure consistent achievement of contractual commitments, service-level agreements, operational targets, customer outcomes, quality standards, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear accountability for delivery performance across practices, business lines, and service portfolios.
* Create a culture of operational excellence, customer focus, transparency, urgency, and disciplined execution.
* Partner with practice leaders and account teams to identify and mitigate delivery risks before they affect customers.
* Serve as the senior executive escalation point for significant delivery, service, operational, and customer issues.
* Lead the stabilization and recovery of complex or distressed customer engagements, including situations involving service disruption, performance deterioration, delivery breakdowns, or customer dissatisfaction.
* Ensure delivery leaders maintain effective operational governance across both long-term customers and new or transitioning engagements.

Shared Delivery and Service Integration
  
  

* Lead an integrated delivery model encompassing staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services.
* Align delivery across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Ensure customers experience one coordinated Atos delivery organization, regardless of the technologies, business lines, or delivery teams involved.
* Establish standardized operating procedures governing service transitions, work transfers, escalations, ownership boundaries, resource deployment, and cross-practice collaboration.
* Eliminate operational silos and reduce delays, ownership confusion, inconsistent practices, and failed handoffs between service areas.
* Define clear roles and decision rights among practice operations, account leadership, client management, solution teams, and delivery organizations.
* Resolve organizational friction, competing priorities, and operational conflicts that impede customer delivery.
* Preserve the technical expertise of individual practices while aligning them around common customer and business outcomes.

Financial and Business Performance
  
  

* Own the financial and operational performance of the North American client delivery organization.
* Drive improvements in margin, productivity, utilization, scalability, delivery quality, and cost efficiency.
* Partner with practice leaders, account leaders, finance, workforce management, and portfolio owners to optimize staffing, capacity, location strategy, and workforce planning.
* Maintain an effective balance between customer commitments, service quality, employee capacity, and profitability.
* Identify structural cost, productivity, and delivery-model improvements that strengthen the performance of the existing book of business.
* Support revenue retention and growth by increasing customer confidence, improving service consistency, and strengthening delivery credibility.
* Establish performance metrics, operating reviews, executive dashboards, and corrective-action mechanisms that provide transparency across the organization.
* Hold leaders accountable for operational commitments, financial performance, risk mitigation, and sustainable improvement.

Customer Experience and Service Excellence
  
  

* Ensure delivery decisions are driven by customer impact rather than internal organizational boundaries.
* Improve customer satisfaction, service quality, responsiveness, reliability, and delivery consistency.
* Partner with account and client leadership teams to understand customer priorities and translate them into executable delivery plans.
* Provide delivery expertise and operational support to account teams without displacing their commercial ownership of the customer relationship.
* Improve the organization’s ability to anticipate customer concerns and resolve issues before they become executive escalations.
* Build strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders during critical delivery situations, service recoveries, and major transformations.
* Reinforce accountability for the entire customer outcome rather than individual service towers, practices, or contractual components.
* Use customer feedback, operational data, service trends, and root-cause analysis to drive measurable improvements.

Transformation, Automation, and AI
  
  

* Develop and execute a transformation roadmap for the North American delivery organization.
* Modernize legacy processes, governance structures, and delivery practices to improve speed, consistency, and accountability.
* Advance the use of AI, automation, analytics, and intelligent operations across service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, accelerate issue resolution, improve service predictability, and enhance the customer experience.
* Establish scalable operating models that support multiple service types, technologies, and customer environments.
* Promote greater use of standardized tools, processes, controls, and performance data.
* Lead the organization through a period of significant change while maintaining service continuity and customer confidence.
* Position the delivery organization to operate successfully in an increasingly AI-enabled technology services market.

Organizational and Practice Leadership
  
  

* Provide leadership and direction to practice and delivery leaders responsible for specialized service portfolios.
* Build a cohesive leadership team aligned around shared customer, operational, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Develop succession plans and strengthen the organization’s delivery, operational, and customer-leadership capabilities.
* Create an environment that rewards collaboration, transparency, responsible decision-making, and enterprise-wide thinking.
* Challenge internal behaviors and legacy structures that prioritize practice interests over customer outcomes.
* Communicate a clear transformation vision and translate that vision into measurable operating priorities.
* Bring energy, resilience, and visible leadership to a large organization navigating substantial operational and market change.

**Required Qualifications**

* Approximately 15 or more years of progressive leadership experience in technology services, client delivery, operations, managed services, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading a large, complex delivery organization, preferably involving more than 1,000 employees or delivery professionals.
* Significant experience overseeing an annual business portfolio, delivery organization, or P&L approaching or exceeding $1 billion.
* Experience operating across multiple technology domains, such as managed infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Proven understanding of staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services operating models.
* A successful record of leading service transformation, organizational integration, operating-model redesign, or enterprise delivery modernization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer escalations, distressed engagements, operational crises, and service-recovery programs.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience with margin improvement, utilization, workforce planning, productivity, cost management, and P&L performance.
* Experience leading through a matrixed organization in which delivery, practices, account teams, sales, finance, and customer leadership have interconnected responsibilities.
* Ability to understand a broad technology services portfolio sufficiently to make sound operational decisions and lead specialized practice executives.
* Executive-level communication, stakeholder-management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution capabilities.
* Willingness to challenge established practices, address performance issues, and make difficult decisions when customer or business outcomes are at risk.
* Demonstrated judgment, self-awareness, resilience, and leadership maturity.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.

Leadership Profile
  
  
The successful candidate will be
  
  

* Customer-centered Consistently prioritizes customer outcomes over internal structures and organizational boundaries.
* Operationally rigorous Establishes clear standards, measures performance, and maintains consistent accountability.
* Transformational Challenges legacy approaches and converts a broad modernization vision into executable change.
* Crisis-tested Remains composed and decisive during major customer, service, and organizational challenges.
* Commercially grounded Understands how delivery quality, cost, customer confidence, and profitability affect one another.
* Enterprise-minded Leads across the entire delivery organization rather than advocating for a single practice or technology tower.
* Influential Aligns senior stakeholders and specialized leaders without relying solely on organizational authority.
* Energetic and resilient Brings visible momentum to a large organization operating through significant change.
* Self-aware Understands their impact on others, listens to competing perspectives, and adjusts appropriately without compromising accountability.
* Decisive Makes timely, evidence-based decisions and accepts responsibility for outcomes.

Location and Travel
  
  
This position may be based anywhere in the United States, with the Irving, Texas area preferred. The role is expected to require occasional travel of up to approximately 25 percent

Title: AI Infrastructure System Engineering - Team Lead
Description:
We are seeking a Systems Support Engineering Team Lead to support the AI server deployment process. In this role, you will be the primary operational point of contact for triaging and resolving issues during software and hardware deployment. You will monitor incoming tickets, diagnose software-related deployment bottlenecks, and collaborate with hardware and networking teams to ensure smooth deployment workflows. The ideal candidate possesses a mix of system administration, basic networking, and hardware troubleshooting knowledge, along with a strong background in Linux environments.
  
  
CIeNET Canada welcomes skilled, dedicated, innovative, and motivated professionals to join our team and build a promising career with us.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Management: Serve as the team lead responsible for coordinating triage operations of the daily System Support Engineering team, including prioritization and validation of issue fixes.
* Follow-the-Sun Handoff PoC: Provide a daily summary of issue triage and resolution support, with clear parameters for escalation and prioritization.
* Frontline Support: Act as the escalation point for automated deployment pipelines and installation scripts.
* Deployment Issue Triage: Monitor, investigate, and manage incoming tickets generated during the hardware and software bootstrapping phases.
* Log & Metric Analysis: Dive into installer logs, operating system metrics, and orchestration workflow histories to determine why a deployment or hardware qualification step failed including:
* Software Diagnosis: Investigate, diagnose, and resolve software-related deployment failures, containerization glitches, or configuration issues (e.g., DHCP, PXE boot, network services).
* Hardware & Firmware Escalation: Identify issues rooted in faulty hardware, outdated firmware, or physical networking constraints, and efficiently route/escalate them to the appropriate hardware engineering or data center technician teams.
* Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Update runbooks, diagnostic playbooks, and error resolution guides to streamline future deployment.
* Collaboration: Act as the bridge between software development, DevOps, and hardware operations teams to drive rapid resolution of blockers

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Linux/OS Administration: Strong proficiency navigating, troubleshooting, and diagnosing issues in Linux environments.
* Networking Fundamentals: Good understanding of IP networking, DNS, DHCP (DHCPv4/DHCPv6), and network diagnostics.
* Hardware & Firmware Knowledge: Familiarity with server components, BMCs (Baseboard Management Controllers), BIOS, and basic physical infrastructure (NICs, switches).
* Containerization & Orchestration: Practical experience troubleshooting in Kubernetes environments (e.g., K3s, custom distributions), CNI plugins, and workload scheduling.
* Ticketing & Tracking Systems: Experience using ticket systems to manage, escalate, and organize operational tasks

**Soft Skills:**

* Team Leadership: Strong leadership and team management ability.
* PoC Management and Communication: Effective communicator and the ability to develop and maintain relationships with customer PoC's in partner engineering teams.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to distinguish between software/configuration issues and physical hardware failures.
* Incident Management: Ability to work well under time-sensitive deployment deadlines (Tier 2 response environments).
* Cross-Timezone Collaboration: Ability to pass off tasks smoothly to global counterparts at the end of a shift (handoff reporting)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bootstrap/Deployment Experience: Experience with netboot/PXE installation processes, or unattended server installation setups.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or workflow orchestration tools.
* Automation/Scripting: Ability to write or interpret basic scripts (Bash, Python) to assist with automated diagnostics.
* DCIM/IPAM Tools: Prior experience working with tools like NetBox or other DCIM/Inventory management systems

**Education And Experiences**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2+ years of computer networking experience
* 2+ years of Linux Operating System experience

**Benefits**

* Extended group insurance including prescription drugs, dental and vision cares
* RRSP employer match
* 15 days annual vacation

CIeNET offers equal opportunities to people. Accommodation is available for applicants with disabilities upon required. We would like to thank all applicants for expressing interest. However only those selected for interviews will be contacted. Reference check of certain positions will be conducted with your permission.

Title: Senior Customer Delivery Manager
Description:
**About the role**

As a Senior Customer Delivery Manager, you will be accountable for leading the delivery of contracted Run Services for a large customer account or a portfolio of smaller accounts.

You will lead and manage teams of people, both directly and through matrix management. You’ll implement and operate an effective governance model to ensure that the services are delivered to satisfy both the Customer’s and Computacenter’s required outcomes, including but not limited to service levels, customer satisfaction and financial targets. You’ll also play a key role in the account leadership team working together to grow Computacenter’s business with the Customer.

You’ll have a role to play as a coach and mentor to other employees to ensure the continuous development of Computacenter and its people, not just as a Line Manager within your own team. You’ll also have a responsibility to engage and play a part as a senior manager in the wider organisation, working within strategic change and ongoing transformational initiatives in our Group Delivery business.

**What you’ll be doing**

* You'll be a part of the Delivery Leadership team, either in your own right or reporting through the Delivery Lead/Senior Delivery Lead to our customers.
* You'll have clear areas of accountability and will be given appropriate autonomy to lead the areas of the service that you are responsible for.
* You'll also form part of a wider community of Delivery Lead’s and will have the opportunity to actively contribute to wider in-country Delivery initiatives.

Delivery Leadership

* Lead and manage the delivery of run and change services to deliver what we’ve promised our customer and our own organization.
* Constantly drive us to do better for our customer and our own organization.
* Objectively manage performance of our internal and partner delivery teams.
* Be able to demonstrate understanding of our performance, what it means to our customer’s business, and what we’re doing to improve.
* Look to continually improve both the efficiency & effectiveness of delivery processes and services, adding value that is relevant to the customer throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Identify risks in service delivery, assess commercial implications and take measures to eliminate risk or avoid risk.

Change Delivery Management

* It’s likely that you’ll have a role leading change for our customers. Sometimes this will be relatively simple in-life service change, sometimes in supporting out Group Services colleagues it will be pulling the Computacenter organization together to deliver more complex change. In carrying out these duties, you will demonstrate awareness of relevant project management approaches.
* You’ll use your contacts and insight to identify new ways in which Computacenter can add value to our customers.

Business Leadership

* Work with the Senior Delivery Manager/Delivery Director as well as Group Services and other colleagues, as appropriate, to support the account strategy and to ensure that Computacenter presents itself as a single, joined-up team to the customer.
* Contribute to and deliver against a communications plan, both customer-facing & internal, ensuring clear & consistent messaging both verbally & in written form across various media.

Contract Management

* Support Group Services in the development, negotiation, and agreement of contract changes within the Customer account.
* Support the management of the contract schedules that relate to your scope of service. You’ll ensure compliance and manage exceptions.

Financial Management

* Manage the finances of your account or assigned services to ensure accurate forecasting and cost management to achieve or exceed financial baselines.

Relationship Management

* Work with the Delivery Lead/Snr Lead and account team to define and support the engagement strategy with the customer and other stakeholders.
* Primary interface to one or more senior stakeholders within the customer organization ensuring that you maintain a positive and constructive relationship to the benefit of both organizations.

**What you have**

* Legally eligible to work in the United States.
* You’ll be an experienced practitioner in IT Service Management.
* You’re likely trained in ITIL, possibly to Expert status.
* You’ll know that it’s not all about ITIL. You’ll be able to show that you understand how IT services fit in a customers’ business and how we as a service provider can add value.
* Perform all Line Management responsibilities for all Direct Reports. Ensure that your team, direct and virtual, is appropriately motivated and engaged and that individual performance is managed.
* Support the people strategy for the account, including capacity and succession planning, people and capability development and talent identification and retention.
* Support the communications strategy in support of the account and employee engagement strategies.
* Use coaching skills to lead and develop Services and other people within the customer account.

**What you can expect**

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

**About us**

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta. www.computacenter.com/us

Title: Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations

Description:
**Job Description**
The Director, IT Infrastructure and Operations leads the teams that keep Liquidity Services’ technology operating reliably every day: Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support. This role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability, and cost-effectiveness of end-user support; server, identity, collaboration, backup, and storage platforms across on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments; and the hybrid network that connects offices, retail locations, warehouse facilities, cloud environments, and remote users. As a hands-on technical leader, the Director sets operational standards and service levels, serves as the senior escalation point for infrastructure and network issues, builds and develops the team, manages vendors and budgets, and leads modernization efforts in partnership with Information Security, DevOps, application teams, and business leaders. Based in the Dallas area, the Director works on-site at the Richardson, TX office several days a week and serves as the senior IT operations leader for that location.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Service availability: Uptime of critical infrastructure, network, and end-user services meets defined targets.
* Service Desk performance: Response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, backlog, and employee satisfaction meet agreed service levels.
* Security and compliance: Servers, endpoints, and network devices are kept current on security patches, vulnerabilities are remediated on schedule, and infrastructure controls pass PCI and SOX audits.
* Resilience: Backups and disaster recovery are tested regularly and meet defined recovery goals.
* Modernization delivery: The infrastructure and network roadmap is executed on schedule and within budget, including removing the dependency on Cisco cloud services routers and delivering new facility builds and site upgrades.
* Financial management: Infrastructure, cloud, telecom, and support spending is managed within budget, with measurable licensing, cloud, and vendor cost savings.
* Team strength: Strong retention, development, and coverage of critical skills across all three teams.
* Lead, manage, and develop the Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support teams, including hiring, goal setting, performance management, coaching, and succession planning.
* Set the strategy and multi-year roadmap for end-user support, infrastructure, and network services, aligned with business priorities, security requirements, and the company’s cloud direction.
* Oversee Service Desk and Field Support operations through the Service Desk Director, including field services across offices, retail locations, and warehouse facilities, and set expectations for service levels, escalation paths, staffing and coverage models, and self-service and knowledge-management practices.
* Own the implementation, delivery, and support of enterprise server and identity platforms, including Windows Server, virtualization platforms, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), ADFS, and DNS/DHCP.
* Own the Microsoft 365 collaboration stack, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams, and the endpoint management platforms that support it.
* Oversee cloud infrastructure across multiple Azure regions and the AWS environment, in partnership with DevOps and application teams.
* Own backup and disaster recovery using Rubrik and Azure Site Recovery, including regular recovery testing, documentation, and business continuity planning.
* Govern enterprise file shares and data storage policies, including retention, PII, access, and user roles, with regular access and integrity audits in partnership with Information Security.
* Drive cloud cost optimization with Server, Development, DevOps, and Database teams using native cloud cost tools.
* Oversee the hybrid network environment, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls and VPN, WAN and internet connectivity, and the program to replace Cisco cloud services routers with cloud-native connectivity between Azure, AWS, and company sites.
* Own infrastructure and network monitoring and alerting (such as PRTG and Datadog), so that issues are detected and resolved before they affect the business.
* Lead IT delivery for new facilities, expansions, relocations, and site upgrades, coordinating network, infrastructure, end-user equipment, and Service Desk readiness.
* Establish and run IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, asset, and request management; lead major-incident response and post-incident reviews, and serve as the senior escalation point for infrastructure issues.
* Serve as the primary liaison between Platform Operations and the Security and Site Reliability (SSRE) team; partner with Information Security on patching, vulnerability remediation, access controls, logging, and segmentation, and support PCI, SOX, and other audit and control requirements.
* Define operational metrics and dashboards, and report service performance, risks, and project status to IT leadership and business stakeholders.
* Develop and manage the infrastructure, cloud, network, telecom, and support budgets; drive cost optimization across licensing, cloud consumption, carriers, and hardware.
* Manage relationships with key vendors, carriers, managed service providers, and contractors; partner with the Contracts team on negotiations, renewals, and service-performance reviews.
* Champion automation, standardization, and documentation to improve reliability and reduce manual work.
* Serve as the senior IT infrastructure leader on-site at the Richardson, TX office and as the escalation point for after-hours critical incidents.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Team or Function Manager: This position manages a team or function and is responsible for hiring, performance management, employee development, and ensuring work is completed in alignment with organizational objectives.
* Directly manages the leaders and senior individual contributors responsible for Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support, including the Service Desk Director who leads help desk and field support technicians.
* Provides second-level leadership for help desk analysts and field support technicians, ensuring consistent service levels, escalation practices, performance expectations, and employee experience across locations.
* Responsible for hiring, performance management, development, and staffing decisions for these teams, and for oversight of contractors and managed service providers supporting these functions.

**Qualifications**
**Education/ Experience**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of experience and certifications.
* Ten or more years of progressively responsible IT infrastructure and operations experience, including at least five years managing technical teams.
* Hands-on background in Microsoft server and identity infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365, in an organization with at least 1,000 employees is preferred.
* Experience leading multiple IT functions, such as platform operations, network engineering, and service desk and field support, in a distributed, multi-site organization.
* Demonstrated success delivering infrastructure, network, or cloud modernization programs.
* Deep knowledge of Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), ADFS, DNS/DHCP, and Windows and Azure security best practices.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams.
* Experience with virtualization platforms, enterprise storage, backup and recovery tools such as Rubrik, and/or Azure Site Recovery.
* Experience with Azure and AWS infrastructure and networking in a hybrid environment.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise networking and network security, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls, VPN, and WAN connectivity.
* Experience leading a Service Desk and IT service management team with defined service levels using an ITSM platform.
* Budget ownership and vendor management experience, including contract negotiation and telecom carrier management.
* Working knowledge of PCI, SOX, and related control and audit requirements.
* Experience with monitoring platforms such as Data Dog, PRTG, or similar enterprise monitoring and observability tools.
* PowerShell scripting, infrastructure-as-code, and automation experience.
* Experience with cloud-native network transit architectures, such as AWS Transit Gateway and Azure Virtual WAN, and migration away from virtual router appliances.
* ITIL 4 certification or equivalent IT service management training.
* Experience supporting retail, warehouse, or logistics operations, and managing geographically distributed, field, or contracted support teams.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Solutions Architect, AWS, CCNP, PMP, or CISSP.

* Ability to balance day-to-day operational demands with long-term strategic initiatives and to manage multiple priorities under pressure

Duties primarily involve prolonged periods of sitting, working on a computer, and communicating via phone and video conferencing.

Compensation is determined by various factors such as location, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as internal and external equity and organizational needs. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Title: Network Operations Manager

+ Participate in managing technology vendors, service providers, maintenance agreements, and licensing.

+ Communicate operational status, project progress, risks, and recommendations to leadership.
+ Participate in institutional planning efforts and technology governance initiatives.

**Required**

* Three (3) years of supervisory or team leadership experience. Ability to train, develop and encourage a staff of technicians.

Experience with and good working knowledge of Domains, Segmentation, Account Management, Network backups, Trusts, Policies, Network Protocols, Bindings, Software Imaging, QoS.

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

* Experience in higher education technology environments.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure and identity management platforms.
* Experience leading cybersecurity, disaster recovery, or infrastructure modernization initiatives.

Description:
PowerON Energy Solutions | Toronto, ON, Canada

Full-time

Hybrid

Job Reference ID: RNXLAODERequisition ID: HLGZSTJWPosted: November 16, 2026

**Job Summary**
  
  
Full-time
  
Hybrid | Toronto, ON, Canada
  
This posting is for a newly created position
  
Salary range $130,000 - $145,000

Reporting to the Senior Manager, IT/OT Infrastructure and Cybersecurity, you will be part of a team developing advanced OT and energy solutions for large business and institutional customers, including electric vehicle charging, battery energy storage systems (BESS), solar PV, microgrids, and distributed energy resources. Your work will directly support the design, deployment, cybersecurity, operation, and lifecycle management of mission-critical operational technology infrastructure that enables the transition to a clean energy economy.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on OT infrastructure practitioner with deep networking expertise and strong practical capability across telecommunications, server infrastructure, cybersecurity implementation, commissioning, and technical documentation. You understand an OT environment end to end, from physical telecommunications and network topology through servers, applications, remote access, and security controls. You translate requirements from OT Cybersecurity, Systems Integration, Engineering, and Operations into reliable, secure, maintainable infrastructure.

This is not a cybersecurity governance or design-only role. You will move between architecture, implementation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and operational support, and own technical problems through to resolution, while helping establish scalable, secure-by-design OT standards across PowerON’s growing fleet electrification portfolio.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**OT Network & Infrastructure Architecture**

* Design, build, and support secure, scalable, and highly available OT network architectures for electrification infrastructure projects including EV charging depots, BESS, DERs, and microgrids.
* Own OT network topology, segmentation, VLANs, routing, switching, and network services.
* Set up and configure servers, virtualization, and supporting infrastructure for OT applications and services, including patching, lifecycle planning, backup configuration, and recoverability.
* Understand and map communication and data flows between server hosts and applications.
* Design and implement secure remote-access architecture.
* Develop network architectures supporting secure integration between OT systems, cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems, and third-party vendor environments.
* Implement resilient industrial network topologies including PRP, HSR, redundant ring architectures, and industrial failover strategies.
* Translate logical architecture into functioning, supportable infrastructure.
* Collaborate with systems integrators, software vendors, consultants, utilities, and engineers of record to ensure alignment between OT network architecture and overall project objectives.
* Evaluate and select OT infrastructure technologies including firewalls, switches, cellular gateways, servers, VPN/remote access technologies, and industrial communications equipment.

**Telecommunications & Site Connectivity**

* Understand and work with the physical network and telecommunications topology supporting operational sites and systems.
* Assess site connectivity and infrastructure dependencies, and how physical connectivity supports the logical OT network architecture.
* Plan for telecommunications requirements during deployment and commissioning.
* Troubleshoot connectivity across physical and logical layers to protect OT system availability and performance.

**OT Cybersecurity Implementation**

* Work with OT cybersecurity leadership to translate cybersecurity architecture and requirements into implemented technical controls.
* Implement network segmentation, security zones, firewall policies, access control rules, and data flow matrices.
* Implement secure remote access for employees, contractors, and vendors, including administration of VPN and privileged access management (PAM) solutions and identity and privileged-access controls for OT systems.
* Harden systems and apply secure configuration across OT infrastructure.
* Carry out patch and vulnerability remediation and implement backup and recovery controls.
* Apply secure-by-design principles aligned with ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and Zero Trust.
* Contribute to cybersecurity risk assessments and technical reviews, and carry out the resulting remediation.

**Project Delivery, Commissioning & Technical Oversight**

* Support projects across the full lifecycle including requirements development, detailed design review, procurement support, FAT/SAT testing, commissioning, and operational turnover.
* Lead infrastructure commissioning and operational readiness, and support the transition from project delivery into operations.
* Own technical problems through to resolution: identify deficiencies, perform root-cause analysis, and establish a practical path to green.
* Coordinate remediation across SCADA, electrical, cybersecurity, and operations teams, and track technical issues through closure.
* Ensure final deliverables align with approved requirements, standards, and operational expectations.

**Operations & Lifecycle Support**

* Provide operational support for deployed OT infrastructure across active electrification sites.
* Support maintenance and lifecycle management of industrial firewalls, managed switches, OT servers, virtualization infrastructure, remote access platforms, and industrial communications devices.
* Support system uptime, reliability, and operational continuity through proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, and coordination with operations teams, contractors and vendors.
* Participate in on-site activities as required to support commissioning, troubleshooting, incident response, and operational support.

**Documentation & Standards**

* Create and maintain logical and physical network diagrams, infrastructure architecture, data-flow documentation, and as-built documentation that accurately reflect the implemented OT environment.
* Maintain operational OT network documentation including IP address schemas, AD roles and permissions, firewall rule matrices, VLAN segmentation documentation, and remote access inventories.
* Develop network and infrastructure requirements and technical design documentation issued to vendors, contractors, and engineering consultants.
* Establish configuration and implementation standards that scale across PowerON’s portfolio.
* Treat documentation as part of engineering delivery, not an afterthought.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* University degree in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting OT networks, industrial infrastructure, SCADA systems, or critical infrastructure environments.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in OT network topology, VLANs, routing and switching, NAT, VPN technologies, firewall policy management, network segmentation, and redundant network architectures.
* Hands-on experience setting up, configuring, patching, and backing up server and virtualization infrastructure in OT environments, including Windows Server.
* Strong working knowledge of physical telecommunications infrastructure and site connectivity, and how they affect OT system availability and performance.
* Experience implementing security controls on industrial networking and security technologies such as Fortinet, Palo Alto, Cisco Industrial Ethernet, and RuggedCom, including system hardening and vulnerability remediation.
* Familiarity with industrial protocols including Modbus TCP/IP, DNP3, IEC 61850, OPC UA, MQTT, and SCADA/EMS systems.
* Familiarity with ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82.
* Experience supporting cloud-connected OT architectures and hybrid IT/OT environments.
* Demonstrated experience commissioning infrastructure, resolving deficiencies, and transitioning projects into operations.
* Experience producing and maintaining as-built documentation, network drawings, and data-flow documentation, and reviewing vendor deliverables.
* Strong troubleshooting and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of driving issues to resolution, not just identifying them.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical risk and remediation paths to engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams, vendors, and partners.

Title: Cloud Service Delivery Manager
Description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Position Summary
  
  
The Cloud Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery, reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of enterprise cloud services across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments. This role serves as the primary liaison between Cloud Operations, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to ensure cloud platforms meet service level objectives, operational standards, compliance requirements, and business expectations.
  
  
The successful candidate will drive operational governance, incident and problem management, service performance, capacity planning, financial optimization, vendor management, and continuous service improvement while fostering a culture of accountability, automation, resiliency, and customer focus.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Delivery & Operations Management
  
  

* Own end-to-end delivery and operational performance of cloud infrastructure and platform services.
* Ensure services meet or exceed defined SLAs, SLOs, availability targets, and customer expectations.
* Lead operational governance reviews and service performance reporting with senior leadership.
* Monitor service health, capacity, utilization, and operational risks across cloud environments.
* Establish and maintain operational runbooks, service documentation, and support processes.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on stability, automation, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
* Lead root cause analysis efforts and ensure corrective actions are implemented for major incidents.
* Develop and track key operational metrics and KPIs.
* Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and DevOps practices to improve platform reliability.
* Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt and improve service quality.

Incident, Problem & Change Management
  
  

* Serve as the escalation point for major incidents and service disruptions.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams during critical issue resolution activities.
* Lead problem management processes to identify recurring issues and implement permanent fixes.
* Ensure effective change management practices minimize operational risk and service disruption.
* Facilitate post-incident reviews and executive communications.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management
  
  

* Act as the primary interface between Cloud Operations and internal business stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Security, Architecture, Risk, Compliance, and Application teams.
* Present service performance, risk assessments, and improvement plans to executive leadership.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment between service delivery and business objectives.

Cloud Governance & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure cloud services operate in accordance with enterprise governance, security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Support audit activities and risk management initiatives.
* Monitor operational controls and remediation activities.
* Drive adherence to cloud operational standards, policies, and best practices.

Financial & Vendor Management
  
  

* Partner with cloud engineering and finance teams to optimize cloud operating costs.
* Monitor cloud consumption trends and support chargeback/showback initiatives.
* Manage relationships with cloud service providers and strategic vendors.
* Participate in contract reviews, service evaluations, and vendor performance assessments.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and mentor cloud operations personnel and service management teams.
* Foster a customer-centric culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support workforce planning, talent development, and succession planning.
* Promote automation-first and cloud-native operational practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in IT Operations, Infrastructure Services, Cloud Operations, or Service Delivery.
* 3+ years of leadership experience managing cloud operations, service delivery, or infrastructure teams.
* Strong knowledge of public cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale cloud environments in highly regulated organizations.
* Deep understanding of ITIL service management principles and operational processes.
* Experience with incident, problem, change, and release management.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, security, resiliency, and disaster recovery.

The Office of Information Technology (OIT) is seeking a

**Essential Functions**

* Strategic Vision & Roadmap Execution: Formulate and execute a multi-year cloud operations roadmap supporting OIT's "North Star" objectives, establishing a foundational infrastructure substrate for Colorado’s state-wide digital delivery initiatives.
* Automated Service Delivery & IaC Maturity: Design and implement a self-service provisioning catalog that transitions the team from a "ticket-first" to a "code-first" operational model, driving the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to ensure 98%+ of infrastructure is deployed via repeatable CI/CD pipelines.

* FinOps & Financial Transparency: Develop and implement fully loaded consumption models that provide agencies with clear, real-time visibility into platform costs, enabling data-driven decisions on modernization and utilization.

* Four (4) years of professional experience in cloud engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or enterprise IT infrastructure, including:
* At least two (2) years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, or operating enterprise workloads in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (and/or AWS).

Meta is hiring a Data Center Capacity and Support Manager to lead the deployment of hyperscale data centers. This central role leads a team of network engineers and coordinates with partners, vendors, and managed service providers to ensure that projects are completed in a timely manner. The manager will build and scale the team, focusing on ownership, speed, quality, and efficiency. Responsibilities include hands-on technical contributions, including design, deployment, and troubleshooting, demonstrating domain expertise and technical impact.
  
  
Data Center Capacity & Network Manager Responsibilities:
  
  

* Manage the deployment, configuration, and ongoing support of large-scale network infrastructure across data centers and global regions
* Act as the escalation point for technical issues, providing hands-on support and guidance to resolve complex problems swiftly
* Develop and maintain relationships with partner teams, vendors, and managed service providers
* Collaborate with engineering, data center, backbone, AI, and equipment vendors to integrate new technologies and drive innovation
* Ensure that project timelines for network turn-ups are met, and ensure that all milestones are met
* Drive deployment quality assurance by performing field walks, managing ENS Network Readiness Checklists, running audits, and ensuring every build meets data center standards
* Distribute the deployment workload among team members based on projections, OKRs, and KPIs across skill sets and priorities
* Drive operational efficiency across policies, processes, and procedures with a focus on standards compliance across the network
* Identify root causes in complex systems and implement process enhancements and automation solutions
* Contribute to the standardization and best practices of design, testing, and implementation of scalable network solutions. Serve as the primary relationship owner for all technical contractors (TCs) and managed service providers (MSPs) in region
* Oversee the site's financial forecasts, budgets, and controls for network build and operations
* Lead by example and build team cohesion and collaboration across regions to ensure alignment with organizational priorities
* Provide mentorship, coaching, and career development to team members

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in network engineering in large-scale data center network deployments, including hands-on responsibility for planning, building, or migrating production networks
* Experience with network incident management, change control processes, and operational tooling for monitoring and alerting in enterprise environments
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional partners including facilities, real estate, and infrastructure teams to deliver network services on time and at scale

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* 5+ years of experience managing / leading network engineering teams involved with large-scale network and wireless deployment programs across multiple physical sites, including hiring, performance management, and team development
* Experience in large-scale network platforms designed for massive scale, high-bandwidth, and ultra-low latency
* Knowledge of various scripting languages and/or programming language principles
* Familiar with packet-based switching, optimized for AI traffic
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

Title: Data Center Manager - Night Shift
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Manage a team that maintains cloud infrastructure for global data center operations!
  
AWS is looking for technology managers with experience in people management, strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take AWS Data Center Operations to the next level. The successful candidate will have experience creating/devising strategies, mentoring people at all levels, sponsoring projects, and proposing technical solutions. This position involves leading teams in hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair and includes participation in an on-call rotation.
  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The successful candidate will be operationally responsible for a Data Center. Some high-level responsibilities include:  

* Prioritize and assign trouble tickets to data center technicians and operators
* Manage the performance of a diverse team(s) of data center operation professionals with varying skills across different locations
* Developing Career Paths for the employees and to make updates in our internal tools.
* Recruit and train data technicians to ensure appropriate staffing levels
* Ensure effective and efficient management of day to day data center operations including queue management, 7/24 shift arrangement and hardware logistics
* Fast learn or act as the subject matter expert across all aspects in data center operations
* Ensure all operational KPIs and metrics are being measured and met
* Inspire and guide improvement in team process, technology innovation and automation
* Manage Large Scale Events (outages) and act as the call leader
* Manage and improve the work-flows and through-put for data centers operations
* Recommend, document, and oversee policies and procedures to meet industry best practices and to meet required SLAs
* Maintain the on-call schedule coordinating absence and vacations
* Be passionate about the quality and quantity of services being provided, and continuously strive to improve our Customer Experience

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
  
Essential Requirements:
  
  

* Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
* Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
* Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

  
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

------------------------

* 4+ years of Information Technology (IT) experience, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 2+ years of people management experience
* 2+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities experience

* Experience in technical writing in a relevant field

Title: Senior Manager - Network Network Development -NRB
Description:
The Network Region Build (NRB) organization plays a critical role in enabling Oracle Cloud Infrastructure’s next-generation Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and High-Performance Computing (HPC) capabilities. NRB is responsible for driving network deployment execution, operational readiness, infrastructure scalability, and customer handover across complex, large-scale GPU cluster environments.

Our mission is to deliver reliable, high-performance, production-ready network infrastructure that supports the rapid expansion of AI/ML workloads and critical GPU delivery commitments. We specialize in deploying and operationalizing advanced RDMA cluster fabrics, ensuring network infrastructure is provisioned, validated, and ready to support demanding distributed computing environments spanning thousands of GPUs.

NRB operates at the intersection of network engineering, infrastructure delivery, and operations, partnering across organizations to accelerate deployment execution, resolve technical dependencies, and ensure seamless transitions into production. We are committed to advancing network deployment methodologies, operational excellence, and AI-driven automation to improve delivery predictability, reduce manual intervention, and scale infrastructure deployment capabilities.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a hands-on engineering leader with strong technical expertise, proven management experience, and demonstrated success delivering complex network infrastructure deployments at scale. This role will lead a team of network development and deployment engineers responsible for provisioning, securing, scaling, deploying, and supporting the network infrastructure required to operate distributed AI workloads across clusters spanning thousands of GPUs.

The position is a critical leadership role within NRB, accountable for network deployment execution, operational readiness, and customer handover across large-scale AI infrastructure programs. The team supports complex RDMA cluster fabric deployments, including IFAB, Multiplanar, QFAB, and commercial region network infrastructure initiatives. The successful candidate will drive execution across multiple concurrent deployments, manage technical dependencies, resolve operational blockers, and ensure network infrastructure readiness aligns with committed GPU delivery timelines.

This leader will also support one of NRB’s strategic AI and automation development swimlanes, partnering with engineering teams to identify automation opportunities, develop and implement scalable solutions, and provide ongoing operational support. These initiatives focus on reducing manual processes, improving deployment efficiency, accelerating network readiness, and increasing operational scalability across the NRB organization.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable leading engineering teams in a fast-paced, highly technical environment, managing complex distributed systems, and supporting infrastructure environments involving hundreds of thousands of network devices. This role requires strong technical judgment, execution discipline, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to balance immediate deployment priorities with longer-term automation and operational improvements.

The position will collaborate extensively with Network Engineering, Operations, CNSE, Data Center Design, Delivery TPM, and other infrastructure organizations to ensure alignment across deployment planning, network readiness, issue resolution, and customer handover. Success requires the ability to translate technical challenges into actionable execution plans, proactively mitigate delivery risks, and drive measurable improvements in network deployment performance and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

BS or MS in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Minimum 7+ years of experience in large-scale physical network infrastructure, network deployment, or production network operations.

Minimum 3+ years of management experience leading network development, deployment, or infrastructure engineering teams at scale.

Demonstrated experience managing engineering teams responsible for complex network infrastructure deployments, operational readiness, and production support.

Strong understanding of large-scale network architectures, RDMA cluster fabrics, high-performance networking, and infrastructure requirements associated with AI/ML and HPC workloads.

Experience with network deployment planning, infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, operational readiness validation, and production handover processes.

Experience building, deploying, or supporting scalable, cloud-native distributed systems and complex network infrastructure environments.

Solid understanding of key cloud networking technologies, including network design and fabrics, networking protocols, network automation, network telemetry, and common hardware platforms.

Experience with network automation development, workflow optimization, and integration of automation solutions into production infrastructure operations.

Familiarity with AI-driven automation capabilities and their application to infrastructure deployment, operational readiness, troubleshooting, and execution efficiency.

Ability to manage multiple concurrent infrastructure deployment programs, prioritize engineering resources, resolve technical dependencies, and drive execution against critical delivery milestones.

Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience coordinating across Engineering, Operations, Infrastructure Delivery, and Technical Program Management organizations.

Ability to communicate complex technical concepts, operational risks, and execution priorities effectively to engineering teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Strong understanding of end-to-end network configuration, technical dependencies, production service behavior, and operational best practices.

Experience with production operations, deployment validation, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and maintaining infrastructure reliability at scale.

Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop engineering talent while building a culture of technical excellence, operational accountability, continuous improvement, and delivery execution.

  

* Value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.
* Able to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment, be results-driven, and thrive even when faced with ambiguity and uncertainty.
* Be a team player, someone who is eager to learn, and willing to do whatever it takes to help the team succeed.
* Own and develop highly available services.
* Lead network development and deployment programs across the cluster networking.
* Attract, develop & manage a team of highly skilled engineers.
* Define and develop roadmaps to deliver network deployment efficiencies.
* Develop, grow, and maintain data-driven metric programs that speak to both the operational and business status of the physical networking domain.
* Solve difficult problems in distributed systems, infrastructure, and highly available services.
* Collaborate with Network Engineering, Network Automation, Network Monitoring, and Network Operations.
* Engineering organizations to deliver a highly available service to our customers.
* Participate in on-call rotation for managers.
